name: Threshold Type 1 Code
definition: Defines whether the threshold was applied on an unsecured or securited basis.

SECU.name: Secured
SECU.definition: Means that once the threshold is breached, collateral must be posted to cover the full exposure.

UNSE.name: Unsecured
UNSE.definition: Means that the threshold provides a predetermined level of free trading. Once the threshold is breached, collateral must be posted to cover the exposure over and above the threshold level.
